findings.evidence: `abbrev diskBoundaryPair` is at Disk.lean:74, and this PR already adds `diskHomeomorphClosedBall` and the `Ball.Homeomorph` import there. The PR description says the relative Hurewicz map of item 4 will reuse `cubeBoundaryPair`, so as placed it would have to import the absolute Hurewicz file.
findings.fix: Move this section to `TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/Disk.lean`, next to `diskBoundaryPair` and `diskHomeomorphClosedBall`. Add the Mathlib import that provides `Cube.boundary` there.
findings.issue: `cubeBoundaryPair`, `diskHomeomorphCube`, `diskHomeomorphCube_mem_boundary_iff`, `diskBoundaryPairToCube` (with its private helpers) and `diskBoundaryPairIsoCube` are general point-set facts about the disk and cube pairs. They do not depend on homotopy groups or homology, yet they sit in the Hurewicz file.

findings.evidence: Singular/DiskSphere.lean:32-34 lists `isZero_singularHomology_diskBoundaryPair_of_ne` and `singularHomologyDiskBoundaryPairIso`, which these declarations copy across along `diskBoundaryPairIsoCube`.
findings.fix: Move them to `TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/Singular/DiskSphere.lean`, next to `singularHomologyDiskBoundaryPairIso` and `isZero_singularHomology_diskBoundaryPair_of_ne`, and import that from Hurewicz.lean.
findings.issue: `singularHomologyCubeBoundaryPairIso`, `singularHomologyCubeBoundaryPairIso_inv` and `isZero_singularHomology_cubeBoundaryPair_of_ne` compute relative singular homology of a pair. They are the cube versions of the DiskSphere results, not part of the Hurewicz construction.

summary: The Hurewicz file also holds general cube-pair material (the pair (Iⁿ, ∂Iⁿ), its isomorphism with the disk pair, and its homology). That material belongs with the disk pair and its homology, not in the Hurewicz file; all other relocations and imports are in their natural place.
